title: Run-Length Encoding
statement:
Compress a string by replacing each run of repeated characters with the
character followed by the length of the run.

## Your function

```
def encode(text):
```

`"aaabbc"` becomes `"a3b2c1"`. Every character gets a count, including
runs of length one.

## Watch out

- The empty string encodes to the empty string.
- Runs of ten or more are written as-is: `"a" * 12` becomes `"a12"`.
- Case is significant: `"aA"` is two runs, not one.
